outcome.description: Semantic outcome of the delegated objective, not the transport status of the Codex turn.

summary.description: Direct engineer-to-engineer summary of what changed, what was observed, and why. Keep this focused on the primary result and actual blockers; offload all validity caveats, untested edge cases, and scope limitations to unverified_edge_cases_and_warnings.

evidence.description: Order by decision value. Each item must state one observation and its exact file, run, command, or record reference. Do not copy logs.

actions_taken.description: One completed action per item. Use the same term for the same operation.

changed_files.description: Exact workspace-relative paths only. Do not add prose.

checks.description: One check per item. Give the exact command and a concise result. Do not copy full command output.

external_effects.description: One external effect per item. Include a stable identifier and the state needed for recovery.

remaining_work.description: One unfinished action per item. Empty when goal_satisfied is true.

recommended_next_step.description: Give one next decision or task. Do not put unfinished current-turn work here.

unverified_edge_cases_and_warnings.description: Dedicated sink for all validity caveats, untested edge cases, environmental noise, and scope limitations. Offload all defensive caveats and limitations here so your code and summary stay focused on the direct happy path and causal results.
